goal: Verify and configure CGKN hybrid API and Ollama operation with bounded latency, strict JSON, credential redaction, and no provider-route changes.
acceptance_criteria: Credentials are stored only in the supported current-user environment configuration, never in repository files, generated artifacts, logs, or commits.
Hybrid-safe routing keeps the reviewed API/provider route as formal generation owner while local support and registered fallback tasks use measured model, context, output, and timeout limits.
Provider, local-model routing, kernel, and credential-redaction tests pass after configuration, with any restart requirement documented.
The installed Ollama service and selected code model complete strict-JSON small, medium, and component-manifest-scale requests through local_model_router with measured elapsed time.
The supplied API credential passes the existing provider smoke route with TLS verification and the configured formal-generation model, and a non-trivial structured request confirms usable quota.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.

control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

provider readiness, routing, kernel, and credential-redaction contracts remain authoritative

feedback: API and both installed Ollama roles completed real structured tasks; hybrid_safe preserves API formal ownership while measured local support settings avoid the prior cold-start and oversized-output timeout pattern.

worked: Testing progressively from minimal JSON to a 21.7k-character manifest separated service availability, cold start, context size, output budget, and timeout effects.
did_not_work: A deliberately low 700-token API manifest budget produced finish_reason=length and was correctly rejected; the current parent process also retains a stale pre-update credential until restart.
experiments: Pre-warm the selected local model before long component work, cap local manifest output at 1024 tokens, allow 180 seconds, and keep API manifest budgets high enough for contract-complete JSON.
